mini_task_spec:
Using the NestJS monorepo located in `test-repo/packages/`, read the `package.json` file in each of the nine sub-packages (`common`, `core`, `microservices`, `platform-express`, `platform-fastify`, `platform-socket.io`, `platform-ws`, `testing`, `websockets`). For each package, collect every entry in its `peerDependencies` field that starts with `@nestjs/` **and** corresponds to one of those nine packages. Treat each such relationship as a directed edge "package A depends on package B". Then, using the graphexport brick's `mermaid` tool with `direction: "LR"`, export the resulting graph as a Mermaid diagram. Node IDs must be valid Mermaid identifiers (sanitize `@`, `/`, `-`, `.` → `_`). Report the complete Mermaid diagram text, exactly as the `mermaid` tool would output it — one code block, starting with `graph LR`, listing all nine nodes alphabetically followed by all edges sorted alphabetically by source then target.
